blocks.text: This year’s The New Nocturnals event once again gathered celebrities and personalities, who flaunted their imaginative costumes inspired by the theme “Silver Screen.” The event, held at the Peninsula Manila on Thursday, Oct. 29, was led by co-founders Mond Gutierrez and Ash Rye, who respectively dressed up as a vampire and “Moulin Rouge’s” Satine. Also joining Mond on the red carpet was Filipino-Irish-British model Christina Nadin, who previously made history as the second Filipino woman to walk the runway of Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show.
